CheckTitle: Ensure All API Based Integrations Use OAuth Authentication
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: Assessor review (the automated check is switched off)
Description: API integrations should authenticate with OAuth 2.0 clients registered in the identity domain, not with Basic Authentication or long-lived static passwords.
Risk: Static credentials can be replayed, cannot be scoped and are hard to revoke.
AuditProcedure: Review SOAP/REST integrations in Fusion and Oracle Integration Cloud.
Confirm integration clients are OAuth clients in the identity domain and no Basic Auth credentials are in use.
Check Fusion audit logs and identity domain logs for Basic Auth requests.

Steps: Register an OAuth client per integration with only the required scopes, move integrations to tokens and revoke Basic Auth credentials.

DefaultValue: OAuth is supported but Basic Authentication is not blocked.
Notes: Manual control. An automated check exists in the code but is switched off; the assessor reviews this control with the audit procedure.
